name: Card Printing
definition: One physical printing of a Magic card in one set, identified by the printing uuid. It is the unit of rows in the cards table and the unit that rulings, legalities and foreign_data rows reference.
scope: Row-level card data in the card_games database; the default entity when a question refers to 'cards' without qualifying identity.

name: Card Identity
definition: The abstract card shared by all of its printings, identified by scryfallOracleId and normally also by name. Many printings, from different sets and years, collapse onto one card identity.
scope: Required whenever a question counts distinct cards, compares a card across sets, or aggregates reprints, rulings or translations per card.

name: Card Set
definition: An expansion or product release that groups printings, identified by a short set code. Sets carry release date, product type, block, parent set and size attributes.
scope: Grouping of printings for release-level, product-level and per-set analysis.

name: Card Face
definition: One face of a multi-face card printing. Faces of the same printing are distinguished by the side marker and linked through otherFaceIds and faceName; they share the printing uuid.
scope: Multi-face layouts only: transform, modal_dfc, split, adventure, aftermath, flip and meld.

name: Ruling
definition: An official clarification of how a card works, carrying an issue date and attached to a card printing uuid.
scope: Card rules clarification content stored in the rulings table.

name: Rarity
definition: The print rarity of a card printing, describing how frequently it appears in boosters of its set.
scope: Filtering and distributing printings by print rarity.

name: Card Color
definition: The set of mana colors that make up the card's color, derived from its mana cost and color indicator. A card with no mana color is colorless.
scope: Color-based grouping and filtering of printings.

name: Color Identity
definition: The full set of colors associated with a card, combining its color with the colors of mana symbols appearing anywhere in its rules text. Used for Commander deck construction rules.
scope: Deck-construction color rules; differs from plain card color for cards with off-color mana symbols in their text.

name: Card Type
definition: The type information of a card: card types (Creature, Instant, Land, ...), supertypes (Legendary, Basic, Snow, ...) and subtypes (Human, Wizard, Equipment, ...).
scope: Type-based grouping and filtering of printings.

name: Tournament Format
definition: A named constructed or limited play format in which a card printing may be legal, banned or restricted.
scope: Format-scoped legality analysis over the legalities table.

name: Legality Status
definition: The legality verdict of a card printing in a format. Only Legal, Banned and Restricted are stored; a printing with no row for a format is not legal in that format.
scope: Value interpretation of the legalities table.

name: Mana Cost
definition: The mana cost printed on a card printing, expressed as a sequence of mana symbols. Printings without a mana cost (predominantly lands) have no value.
scope: Cost composition of printings; the direct input to converted mana cost.

name: Language
definition: A natural language in which card text or set names are additionally published. The same language vocabulary is used for card-level and set-level localization.
scope: Localization analysis across foreign_data and set_translations.

name: Set Type
definition: The product category of a set, such as expansion, core, promo, masters, memorabilia, token or funny.
scope: Distinguishing playable expansions from promotional or collectible products.

name: Set Release Date
definition: The calendar date on which a set was released, which orders sets in time and bounds the card pool available to a format at a given moment.
scope: Temporal filtering and ordering of sets and their printings.

name: Converted Mana Cost
definition: The total amount of mana in a card's mana cost, computed by summing its mana symbols. Stored per printing, and separately per face for multi-face printings.
scope: Quantitative cost analysis of printings.

name: Creature Power
definition: The power of a creature, describing the damage it deals in combat. Stored as text because some cards use variable or symbolic power.
scope: Quantitative comparison of creatures by combat strength.

name: Creature Toughness
definition: The toughness of a creature, describing the damage it can survive. Stored as text because some cards use variable or symbolic toughness.
scope: Quantitative comparison of creatures by resilience.

name: Reprint
definition: A card printing that is not the first appearance of its card identity, i.e. the card was already printed in an earlier set.
scope: Reprint-history analysis over card identities and sets.

name: Card Localization
definition: The name, type line, rules text and flavor text of a card printing published in a non-English language.
scope: Card-level translation coverage across languages.

name: Set Localization
definition: The translated name of a set in a given language.
scope: Set-level translation coverage across languages.
